press.scope: Biondi, Mei and Malanga, signed March 2025 press abstract. Page 2 lists providers, page 5 gives the base reference, eight and 648 m, page 6 figures, page 7 separate plateau-wide ~2 km interpretation. The PDF has seven pages and zero embedded files (pdfinfo and pdfdetach -list).

conference.scope: Original Italian conference recording. Inspect 03:02:00 tube diameter assumption, 03:02:40 section drawing and 03:03:10 rescaled version of this section.

gallery.scope: Gallery reproduces the original Italian presentation after a translated selection. The April times in PNG names are capture names. Exact byte fingerprints and links for five preserved slides are in result.json.

dimension.scope: Projected wireframe superimposed on colored section. 304/152 m horizontal guides and 137/648/785 m vertical guides. A single composite dimension, no eight measured termini.

author_marks.scope: Leaders 1-8 on the initial horizontal tomogram. Caption explicitly says the traces were identified on revisiting the image after other tomograms.

cube.scope: ~80 m cube side is derived assuming descending tube diameter ~20 m. Neither dimension is an independent control for the other.

model.scope: Additional overhead CAD rendering. No earth-coordinate or elevation axis on this slide.

orientation.scope: West described at right on a related view, but this slide calls it a vertical tomogram. The annotated plan does not identify surveyed corner coordinates or geotransform.

pano.scope: See full gallery for labeled plateau section lines. Page 7 of press PDF has numeric ticks without a vertical unit or time-to-depth transfer; it is a different section.

petrie.scope: Petrie, The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh, chapter VIII section 66, p. 97. Mean of four sides 8474.9 inches. Section 67 reconstructs original apex; do not substitute it for the displayed 137 m.

khufu_paper.scope: Earlier Khufu study, section 4 figure 8d/equations 21-24 and numerical example on p.16. Table 2 identifies COSMO-SkyMed observations by date, beam, polarization, orbit, and purpose. Internal results concern Khufu only.

retraction.scope: The journal retracted the 2022 paper in August 2026; authors disagreed. Separate from March 2025 claim.

patent.scope: Method description including focusing and geocoding; not a manifest of runs for the March 2025 press release.

michels.scope: Dec 2025 Jesse Michels interview, 03:53-06:07. Biondi describes structures connected to the Khafre base, more than 1 km depth, then four plus four tubes and two ~80 m chambers. He does not reconcile this description with the 648 m bracket here.

rogan.scope: Jan 2026 Joe Rogan interview. 26:03-27:06 discusses collapsed access shafts between Khafre and the Sphinx; Biondi attributes ~600 m to tomography. Different proposed access paths.

field.scope: Project update reports an August 2026 field application. This is a request for field work, not ground measurements.

comparison.scope: November 2026 ARF report. Khafre east/west companion images have nominal depth range to 50 m. Khufu/Osiris/cemetery outputs and ICEYE X13/X33 references are separate.

muons.scope: Alvarez et al., Science 1970, 167, 832-839. Second Pyramid. Detector near the base in the Belzoni chamber, searched in a cone extending upward, half-angle 35 degrees. Deep lower endpoints lie outside the tested volume.

site_velocity.scope: Site geophysical refraction surveys constrain shallow geological velocities at surveyed locations. They do not establish an effective 648 m path velocity, mode or forcing spectrum under the footprint.

actual_calibration.scope: An example of local wave speed and known-reflector calibration on a different accessible target, the Khufu North Face Corridor.

open_capella.scope: Candidate provider dataset. Product URLs below come from the project inventory.

author_public_digital: signed PDF with embedded color rasters
numbered plan, two color renderings, dimensioned section, CAD screenshots
method paper on Khufu and patent application
availability.coordinates: Platform search center in the local catalog is 31.1308 E, 29.9761 N for Khafre. It is not a list of shaft coordinates. Eight figure-space marks and sketch directions exist, but no per-shaft surveyed WGS84 positions, uncertainty or signed geotransform in the reviewed author evidence.
availability.elevation: 137 m top above footprint base, base is local zero for the stated 648 m bracket, total 785 m. No published geodetic zero, 8 top/bottom picks, original depth bins, per-bin times, or velocity profile tied to this slice were identified.
availability.providers: March press abstract identifies Capella and Umbra. In the reviewed primary materials no collect ID, date/time, or figure-to-acquisition mapping for the 648 m dimension was found. Scope is the listed sources, not a provider archive-wide impossibility claim.
availability.time: Public comparison collects have UTC times, state vectors and radar sampling rates. They time the radar acquisition. The team does not provide a timed acoustic arrival, source onset, per-look complex Y, signed baselines, seismic wavelength or acoustic speed calibration for this section.
unrecovered: author input files identified per figure
author extraction lines with surveyed endpoints and vertical datum
original prerecolor numeric volume, shifts, axes, and units
